items.exampleEn: She works in the sales division of a large company.
items.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司的業務部門工作。

items.exampleEn: The shop lowered its prices to attract more customers.
items.exampleZh: 這家店降價以吸引更多顧客。

items.exampleEn: The creation of the new website took six months.
items.exampleZh: 建立新網站花了六個月。

items.exampleEn: The city launched an initiative to plant more trees.
items.exampleZh: 市政府推出一項多種樹的新措施。

items.exampleEn: The statue shows a man in a thinking pose.
items.exampleZh: 這座雕像是一名男子沉思的姿勢。

items.exampleEn: It took us a year to implement the new computer system.
items.exampleZh: 我們花了一年才讓新的電腦系統正式上線。

items.exampleEn: Thank you for your involvement in this project.
Good lighting can enhance the look of a room.
items.exampleZh: 好的照明能提升房間的質感。

items.sentenceEn: The new rules will be implemented across all divisions next month.
items.sentenceZh: 新規定下個月將在所有部門實施。

items.audioEn: Could everyone please lower their voices? The baby is sleeping next door.
items.audioZh: 大家可以把聲音放低一點嗎？寶寶在隔壁睡覺。

items.sentenceEn: Parents' involvement in school activities helps children do better.
items.sentenceZh: 家長參與學校活動，有助於孩子表現得更好。

items.sentenceEn: The photographer asked us to hold the same pose for ten seconds.
items.sentenceZh: 攝影師要我們維持同一個姿勢十秒鐘。

items.stemEn: Adding fresh herbs will ____ the flavor of the soup.
items.stemZh: 加入新鮮香草會增添湯的風味。

items.stemEn: No one asked him to help; he did it on his own ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有人要他幫忙；他是自己主動去做的。

items.passageEn: Last year, our company started a new initiative to save energy. The idea came from a young engineer in the design division, who took the initiative and wrote a plan herself. The managers liked it and supported the creation of a small team to implement it right away. The plan was simple: lights turn off automatically when a room is empty, and the air conditioning is set two degrees higher. These changes lowered our electricity bill by fifteen percent. Additionally, the plan enhanced our image with customers. Everyone's involvement was important. At the end of the year, the whole team gathered for a photo, and the engineer stood in the middle in a proud pose.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們公司推出一項新的節能措施。這個點子來自設計部門的一位年輕工程師，她主動自己寫了一份計畫。經理們很喜歡，支持成立一個小組馬上實施。計畫很簡單：房間沒人時燈會自動關掉，冷氣溫度調高兩度。這些改變讓我們的電費降低了百分之十五。此外，這項計畫也提升了公司在顧客心中的形象。每個人的參與都很重要。年底時，全體團隊聚在一起拍照，那位工程師站在中間，擺出驕傲的姿勢。

questions.questionZh: 這個節能計畫是誰提出的？
options: 總經理辦公室的一位年輕秘書
一位常來公司的老客戶
設計部門的一位年輕工程師

questions.questionZh: 這個計畫帶來了什麼結果？
options: 產品價格上漲了百分之十五
員工人數增加了十五個人
公司的辦公室搬到市中心
電費降低了百分之十五

items.promptZh: 公司下個月會實施新的休假制度。
referenceEn: The company will implement a new leave policy next month.
Next month, the company is going to implement a new holiday system.
rubricZh: implement 後面接政策、計畫等（例如 implement a new policy）
「會實施」可用 will、be going to 等表示未來的寫法；「休假制度」可寫 leave policy、holiday system 等

items.instructionZh: 用 enhance 造一個句子，說說你做了什麼來提升某樣東西（例如技能、外觀）。
referenceEn: I take online classes to enhance my English skills.
I fixed the old windows to enhance the value of my apartment.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 enhance，後面接被提升的事物（例如 enhance my skills）
句子要說到你自己做的事
